source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed brake tests in a vehicle inspection report

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Get vehicle history
3. Must have all record/manuals with the vehicle.
4. Get vehicle serial number or vin number.
5. Get name, address of last service provider. 


Get a detailed copy of the last recorded service to the vehicle.

## How to gain access to the remote access module device of the truck.

To be clear, how to develop a test for the brake-system.

Each vehicle manufacturer has a unique system to gain access to the Remote Access Modules. Contact the vehicle manufacture for an account and follow their instructions.

## Why is the brake-system so critical.
Because the brakes of the vehicle stop all forward momentum, therefore, a failed brake system is catastrophic to life and safety of vehicle and other road users. 

The crash severity will be directly related to the braking speed and the reaction time of the cab driver. 
Brake action is a complex event to resolve vehicle
